rationale: Two omissions, found by script/m14/tmp/css-omission-audit.ts rather than by a fixture. 1) A `font-family` naming a DECLARED `@font-face` emitted nothing, while the identical `animation` -> `@keyframes` path had been emitting since the order-dependence fix — 135 corpus files declare a `font-family`, 21 declare an `@font-face`, 344 family symbols were published and NOTHING connected them. 2) A `var(--brand)` read emitted `references` to `--brand` while the only published symbol was `@property --brand`, so the read pointed at a name nothing published — a dangling endpoint in a lane whose whole chain rule is that both ends resolve. The edge is also pinned to name the DECLARATION (`@font-face Inter`) rather than the bare family, because that is the published symbol; a bare `Inter` is an endpoint that resolves to nothing.
_targetSpelling: CSS-D15: a target that names a declaration THIS file publishes is spelled `<file-scope>::<name>`, where the scope is the file's project-relative path without its extension. The bare spelling stays for a target this file does not declare (a cross-file or external reference) and for `imports`, whose target is another file's module name.
